review_candidates.title: People & Talent, Lead
review_candidates.location: WP. Kuala Lumpur, Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
review_candidates.description: Why this role exists Emerge is building Southeast Asia’s specialist insurance intermediary for new and emerging risks. We run a group of commercial insurance brands across Malaysia, Singapore and Labuan, on AI and with a small, sharp team. In an intermediary business, our people and what they know are the product. We win when our team gets sharper every quarter: better at understanding risk, better at advising clients, better at using our tools. Today, the founders do all the hiring, training and people work alongside everything else, and that limits how fast we can grow. We need one person to own it: bring in the right people, build the training and culture that keeps raising our skills, and later run the incentive system that rewards our sales team. This is a Lead role. You will set up the people function from scratch, own its results, and work directly with the Group CEO. It is not an HR admin role. What you will own 1. Talent acquisition Own every open role from start to finish: role scorecard, job post, sourcing, screening, interviews, offer and start date. Hire for our internal team across the group: account executives and sales, placement and technical roles, operations, technology, and graduates. Go out and find great people instead of waiting for them to apply: direct outreach, referrals, universities and industry networks. Keep a bench of promising people so we never start a search from zero. Run a clear, fair process so the team interviews and decides consistently. Push back when a hire is wrong, even if the seat is empty. Learn why candidates say yes or no, and feed that back into how we hire. 2. Training and skills building Own the first 90 days for every new joiner: what to learn, who to learn from, and what good looks like by day 30, 60 and 90. Build and run the Emerge Academy : a repeatable training path in product and class knowledge, placement, client handling, compliance and our AI tools. Run a regular internal learning rhythm (for example, weekly sessions and case reviews) with our Head of Placement, business leads and insurer partners, so the whole team keeps getting better, not just new joiners. Get people through fit and proper checks, licensing and the insurance qualifications their role needs (MII, CII or equivalent), and track progress. Measure whether training works: time to first placement, exam pass rates, and manager feedback. 3. Culture and employer brand Help define and write down how we work: our values, how we make decisions, what good looks like. Then make it real through hiring, onboarding, recognition and how we deal with problems. Build a culture where intermediaries want to build their careers: learning is constant, credit is fair, and people are backed. Turn that into our employer brand: job posts, LinkedIn content, referral programme and campus talks. Notice early when someone is unhappy. Run exit conversations with every leaver and bring the lessons back to the CEO. 4. Performance and management Set clear goals for everyone, with a regular check-in rhythm between people and their managers. Run the review cycle and help managers give fair, specific feedback. Managers make the final call. You make sure the process is consistent. Coach first-time managers on how to run 1:1s, set expectations and have hard conversations. Build career paths for both tracks: sales and client-facing (account executive to account manager to team lead) and technical or operations. Support pay decisions with market data, and keep offers and raises consistent. 5. Sales incentives Work with the CEO and finance to design commission and incentive plans for the sales team that reward the right behaviour: new business, retention, profitable placements and compliant selling. Run the plans: targets, tracking, monthly or quarterly calculations, payout sign-off and clear statements for each person. Handle credit-split questions and disputes fairly and quickly. Review the plans every year against results and market practice, and recommend changes. 6. People operations Own employment contracts, policies and people records, with outside counsel where needed. Keep people processes in line with our regulators’ expectations for licensed intermediaries (Bank Negara Malaysia, Labuan FSA and MAS where relevant). Keep things confidential. Always. What we’re looking for Must have 5 to 8 years in recruitment, talent or people roles, with at least some of it in-house at a startup or growing company. Proof that you can find people who were not already looking. Experience hiring sales or client-facing people. Hands-on experience building at least one of: onboarding, a training programme, goal setting, performance reviews or career paths. Good judgment about people, and the ability to explain it. Comfortable with numbers and tracking. You will run incentive calculations, so you must be accurate. Calm in hard conversations with candidates, team members and managers. Clear and warm in English and Bahasa Malaysia. Uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT or similar) every day. Strong advantage Experience in insurance, banking or financial services. Experience designing or running commission or incentive plans for a sales team. Experience building a training academy or graduate programme yourself. Insurance qualifications (MII, CII), or willingness to complete one. The kind of person who thrives here You measure your success by how the people you hired are doing a year later. You would rather push back on a hiring manager than fill a seat with the wrong person. People trust you, because you are fair and you keep things confidential. You like building from scratch and do not need a big HR team around you. What we offer The first people role in a fast-growing specialist intermediary, with a direct line to the Group CEO. Room to build the function, and the team under it, as the group grows.

Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build that judgment with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a backlog of manual checks in front of you. Strong working knowledge of keyword research, search-term analysis, negative keywords, audience signals, bidding strategies and budget pacing. Strong analytical skills, including experience using Google Ads, Google Analytics and Excel or Google Sheets to interpret campaign data and develop actionable recommendations. Understanding of CRO and A/B testing principles, including how ad messaging and landing-page experience influence campaign performance. Practical experience using AI tools for research, analysis or campaign execution, with the judgment to validate outputs before applying them. Strong attention to detail, organization and communication skills, with the ability to manage the daily campaign workflow, seek approvals and collaborate effectively in a remote team. Experience running Google Ads campaigns targeting the US market. Hands-on experience with Google Merchant Center, product-feed optimization and resolving product or feed-related issues. Experience implementing or troubleshooting conversion tracking using GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Experience using Google Ads Editor, Google Ads Scripts, APIs or other automation tools to improve campaign management and reporting. Current Google Ads certification. Je weet mensen uit te dagen, duidelijke richting te geven en tegelijkertijd ruimte te laten voor initiatief en persoonlijke groei. Je werkt met attributiemodellen, dashboards en analyses om continu te optimaliseren en maakt actief gebruik van AI en automatisering om campagnes slimmer, sneller en schaalbaarder te maken. Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van E-commerce, Brand Marketing, Retail en Buying. Samen zorg je ervoor dat performance marketing niet op zichzelf staat, maar een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan onze commerciële doelstellingen én de groei van het merk. Je beheert en optimaliseert substantiële mediabudgetten met focus op rendement, groei en incrementaliteit. Je geeft leiding aan het Performance Marketing-team en bent verantwoordelijk voor coaching, ontwikkeling en performance binnen het team. Je stimuleert eigenaarschap en helpt collega's om inhoudelijk én persoonlijk te groeien. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van campagnes en weet het team inhoudelijk uit te dagen. Je analyseert data, attributiemodellen en marketingprestaties en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete verbeteringen. Je implementeert AI-oplossingen en automatiseringen om campagnes slimmer en efficiënter te maken. Ce programme vise à renforcer la sécurité énergétique régionale, à réduire les coûts de l’énergie et à favoriser l’accès à une électricité fiable et abordable en Afrique de l’Ouest, en améliorant la capacité de la Côte d’Ivoire à échanger de l’électricité sur le marché régional. Représenter les projets de MCA-Côte d’Ivoire lors de réunions, conférences et autres événements, en promouvant leurs réalisations, les bonnes pratiques mises en œuvre et leur contribution au développement du secteur.
